subject: Request: Chiron pilot latency carveout + pricing concession
content:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@chiron.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Chiron pilot latency carveout + pricing concession

Marissa / Ben —

Quick one: Chiron (contact: Sarah Nguyen, CTO) is asking for a short-term SLO carveout for their 90-day pilot. Key facts:

- Account: Chiron Systems (seed-stage healthtech) — pilot could lead to $650k ARR in 2027 if successful.
- Pilot footprint: single-region US-west, heavy bursty inference (chat + embeddings).
- Ask: reduce uptime guarantee to 99.5% for pilot window (currently standard is 99.95% for this tier) and allow a higher latency tail for cold starts; cap service credits for any breaches at a fixed dollar amount.
- Commercial ask: 15% pilot discount on hosted consumption + waived onboarding fees.

Risk/mitigation in brief:
- Pilot constrained to a dedicated burst pool; we can limit blast radius to a named project.
- Telemetry + a short playbook of fallback variants to be required.

Attachments: Chiron_MutualActionPlan_v3.pdf, chiron-usage-forecast.csv (attached)
HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/contacts/CH-3419

Can you run this against policy and advise what would need exec signoff? If we can get an expedited decision today (Sarah is pushing to sign the pilot contract), I can lock the schedule.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@chiron.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 13:30:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Chiron pilot latency carveout + pricing concession

Aditya —

Thanks for the detail and the MAP. I reviewed current precedent and the deal desk position is below. This needs an exec signoff because the uptime deviation and the credit cap you're proposing are outside standard commercial guardrails.

Proposed (deal-desk rec):
- Pilot SLO: 99.5% uptime (90-day pilot).
- Service credit: capped at $5,000 total for the pilot (rather than % of spend).
- Discount: 10% pilot discount (consumption) with onboarding fee waived.
- Conditions: must implement KV-cache prefixing and use the smaller sequence QP model variants during peak; we require telemetry streams (token-level latency + error rates) and a weekly sync for the pilot.

Rationale: a 99.5% pilot window is a reasonable compromise for bursty workloads, but we reduce financial exposure by capping credits at a fixed dollar amount and lowering the discount.

What we need from Execs: signoff on uptime deviation (from 99.95 -> 99.5 for pilot) and approval of the credit cap + discount. If execs want a shorter pilot window or different cap, state explicitly.

If approved, I'll draft the carveout language for the SOW and route to legal for a 24-hour turnaround.

Attachments: precedent_matrix_Q3.pdf (internal)

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Deal Desk Manager
marissa_cole@redwood.com

-----
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@chiron.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 16:02:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Chiron pilot latency carveout + pricing concession

Marking approved with modifications. Thanks for pulling the trade-offs together, team.

Executive decision (Avery Johnson):
- Approve temporary SLO of 99.5% uptime for the pilot but limited to 60 days (not 90). This reduces our exposure while enabling Chiron to validate.
- Approve a one-time pilot discount of 12% (compromise between 10/15).
- Approve a service-credit cap of $7,500 for the pilot period.
- Approve waived onboarding fees.

Non-negotiable conditions to include in SOW/Order Form:
1) Telemetry feed (token-level latency + error rates) forwarded to Redwood monitoring in real time OR a daily dump if real time isn't possible.
2) Fallback variant requirement: Chiron must accept automatic model fallback to the 1.5B quantized variant during cold-start spikes.
3) Pilot termination clause: If Chiron exceeds 85% of committed usage for three consecutive weeks, we reserve the right to revisit pricing/terms.

Marissa — please draft the SOW carveout language, tag Legal (legal@redwood.com) and EngOps for the telemetry integration. Aditya — please notify the customer and confirm acceptance of the 60-day window.

Avery Johnson
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com
